subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

P + Q means ‘P is the father of Q’,

P & Q means ‘P is the wife of Q’,

P @ Q means ‘P is the sister of Q’ and

P # Q means ‘P is the wife of Q’.

Based on the above, how is Y related to Z if ‘Y @ G & E + V @ Z’?
solution:

Given: Y @ G & E + V @ Z

It means: Y is the sister of G, G is the wife of E, E is the father of V, V is the sister of Z.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d60a7bbe860393c77a61852b3bbbd9d839198914c9e0e460b9817facc90dcfe8.png] 

Thus, Y is Z's Mother’s sister.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
